title: Joomla Apply: a template that ships one language is written in the language the owner picked
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/brief-joomla.test.mjs

S2: Record the exit code, the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines and the result of each case whose name starts with: "a template that ships one language is written in the language the owner picked, not in English by default"; "a template that ships one language is written in it and has nothing to hide".
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 55).

Every named case is 'ok' (none 'not ok', none '# SKIP'): the planner writes every line of a one-edition template in the first language the owner gave (de-DE in the case), not en-GB, and the 'only X was written' note fires only when more than one language was picked.
evidence: Ledger L11b, 05/10/2026: a customer who picked German for a Joomla template that ships one edition got English copy and the report 'only en-GB was written': normaliseLocales puts en-GB first and the engine wrote languages[0]. Red f06bf8ed3, fix de3c32aca.
fence: Two-edition templates are unchanged; the site's own interface language (language pack, <html lang>) stays as the template installs it.

tests: a template that ships one language is written in the language the owner picked, not in English by default
a template that ships one language is written in it and has nothing to hide
